bio.text: Kris Mayes is the Arizona Attorney General, elected in 2022, and is the Democratic candidate for re-election in 2026.

Born and raised in Prescott, Mayes studied political science and journalism at Arizona State University, worked as a reporter, and later earned a master's in public administration from Columbia University and a law degree from ASU.
Mayes served in the Napolitano administration and was a member of the Arizona Corporation Commission from 2003 to 2010, chairing it from 2009 to 2010.
Before becoming Attorney General, Mayes was a professor at ASU's School of Global Sustainability.
